narrative.overview:
The system is her Facebook flyer's colors and images turned into a phone-first page that ends in a written order. Off-white paper alternates with two deep flyer greens in full-width bands. The logo's lime is the only accent, and it marks what to tap. Six images in `img/`, all crops of that flyer, supply all of the food color: the logo, a hero shot, and four cup images.

Density is low and the page is linear: header, hero, four cups, how it works, order builder, close, footer. Surfaces are flat, corners are generous, and actions are pills or circles. From 760px the layout widens in two steps without changing that sequence.

The page moves little. The hero heading animates in once, content below the first screen fades up 12px once, and the message circle slides in after the hero.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width paper and green bands, with white cards only on paper.
One accent, lime, as a fill carrying deep ink, or as text on dark bands.
Cal Sans at a single weight for every named thing, and a system stack for running text.
Pills for actions, circles for small controls, 24px corners for containers.
Flat at rest, with one shadow on the page.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only accent in the interface. Greens and paper are grounds, and red in the interface is reserved for errors.

rules.name: The Lime Carries Ink Rule
rules.body: Every lime fill has Ink (#10341f) on it, in buttons, discs, the message circle and text selection.

rules.name: The Lime On Dark Rule
rules.body: Lime appears as text only on green bands: the accent phrase in a heading, and the footer link on hover. The page's direction note says lime is always a fill. The build also sets it as text on dark, and the build is what this records.

rules.name: The One Weight Display Rule
rules.body: Cal Sans is always set at 400. Hierarchy comes from size and ground, never from a heavier cut.

rules.name: The Name Or Sentence Rule
rules.body: Headings, names, prices, counts, labels and buttons are Cal Sans. Sentences, sublabels and typed input are the system stack.

rules.name: The Open Word Rule
rules.body: Cal Sans at small sizes carries .01em letter spacing and .06em word spacing, on buttons, cup names, order line names, field labels, step titles and the Facebook card. Headings use -.005em and no word spacing.

rules.name: The 44 Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing tappable is under 44px: brand link and footer link 44px, arrow disc 44px, stepper 46px, input 52px, button 56px, message circle 60px.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, the form and buttons carry no shadow. The single shadow belongs to the one fixed element.

dos: Do put Ink (#10341f) on every lime fill.
Do switch the focus ring by ground: 3px at 3px offset, in Focus Green on light and Logo Lime on green bands.
Do put hover styles inside a hover-capable media query, so taps don't leave them stuck on.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion state: smooth scroll, transitions and fade-up off, the heading static.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or larger, and form text at 16px.
Do use drawn SVG icons from the shared set: arrow, message, plus, minus, each in currentColor.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue to the interface.
Don't set lime as text on paper or white.
Don't make the message action a bottom bar. It is one circle.
Don't animate content that is already on the first screen with the fade-up. It applies only below the fold.
Don't lay a tint or overlay over the hero image.
Don't set Cal Sans heavier than 400.
